concerns.text: T003 implements a 5-feature node list ('element fraction, atomic number, electronegativity, valence electrons, atomic radius') while FR-002 still mandates exactly 4 features [atomic number, electronegativity, valence electrons, atomic radius]. The deviation is flagged for kickback but the spec is unamended, so the task as written is formally non-conformant with the FR it tags. The spec must be revised (or the task must not claim FR-002 satisfaction) before execution.

T007 tags FR-006 but delivers only the RF-baseline portion; the FR's core clause 'ΔR² = R²_composition − R²_structure-aware on the shared test set' is not computed, and T010 reduces FR-005/FR-011 to code-path stubs. Constitution Principle VI (NON-NEGOTIABLE-adjacent: 'every evaluation metric reported MUST explicitly compare... against a structure-aware baseline') remains unamended. The gating is honest, but the tasks cannot proceed to any scientific claim (T007/T013) until the spec/constitution kickback actually lands; tasks.md should make T007/T013 explicitly blocked on the spec revision, not merely 'gated' on data.

FR-007 and US-1 scenario 2 require a '95% confidence interval'; T006/T008 deliver a 'fold-disagreement band' and explicitly relabel it. Statistically justified, but the spec wording is unchanged, so the acceptance scenario's verification condition is not what any task produces. Spec must be amended or the acceptance criterion silently dropped.

FR-008 names formation energy and bulk modulus as example correlation targets; T009 restricts to thermal conductivity, sound velocity, first ionization energy and excludes bulk modulus. The exclusion reasoning (quasi-circularity) is sound, but the allowed property list diverges from the spec without a spec revision — a silent narrowing of FR-008's scope.

US-1 scenario 1 and the data model name the deliverable 'results_composition_only.json'; T007 and the metrics schema emit 'data/results/composition_only.json'. Filename mismatch will fail the acceptance scenario as literally written. Align one name across spec, data model, contract, and tasks.

US-1 scenario 3 says the system 'halts execution' when training exceeds 30 minutes per epoch; FR-009 and T005's runtime guard specify warn-and-continue for the per-epoch limit and halt only at 6 h total. T005 follows FR-009, silently dropping the acceptance scenario's halt-on-epoch-timeout criterion. The spec contradiction must be resolved and the surviving criterion reflected in T005's verification.

The spec's edge case for composition-only and structure-aware models yielding identical performance (ΔR² ≈ 0) has no handling, test, or documented-analysis task. T010's extension path should specify how this outcome is reported if the CIF source is restored.
